description: Claude bot PR review findings — per-PR summaries. Append one entry per merged PR.

queries.category_trend: jq '[.reviews[] | .by_category | to_entries[]] | group_by(.key) | map({category: .[0].key, total: (map(.value) | add)})'
queries.most_flagged_files: jq '[.reviews[] | .flagged_files | to_entries[]] | group_by(.key) | map({file: .[0].key, total: (map(.value) | add)}) | sort_by(-.total)'
queries.severity_distribution: jq '[.reviews[] | .by_severity | to_entries[]] | group_by(.key) | map({severity: .[0].key, total: (map(.value) | add)})'

reviews.title: UI component library with full codebase migration
reviews.notes: Migration PR. 12 rounds. Hit rate: R1-7 95%, R8 57%, R9 50%, R10 100% (2), R11 25% (1/4), R12 25% (1/4). Converged — bot now flags pre-existing code and repeats fixed findings.

reviews.title: Move PDF generation server-side to eliminate unsafe-eval CSP
reviews.notes: Security-focused PR. 7 rounds. R1: 5 findings (3 valid, 1 acknowledged, 1 FP). R2: 6 (5 valid, 1 skipped). R3: 3 (1 valid, 2 repeats). R4: 2 (both repeats). R5: 6 (2 valid — stampede guard, socket leak; 4 FP/repeat). R6: 0. R7: 1 valid (cache invalidation). Bot converged R6-R7. Also drove fetchBackend utility extraction across 28 API routes and /simplify cleanup (saveAs reuse, prop narrowing).

reviews.title: Generic draft recovery for all editors
reviews.notes: 100% hit rate — all 6 findings valid. R1: 3 (premature fetchDoneRef, legacy key migration breaks existing drafts, missing cover position dirty tracking). R2: 3 (shallow photo essay comparison, savedAt pollution in legacy migration, missing dirty tracking for publish/cover). R3-R4: 0. Bot converged immediately after fixes.

reviews.title: Video poster frame and correct dimensions on upload
reviews.notes: Complex PR — 16 rounds, 48 findings (54% valid). Key catches: promise leak from settled flag ordering, iOS Safari DOM requirement, boolean attr regex data corruption, GCS blob path double-prefix, captureFrame race condition, zero-dimension guard, NaN duration guard. Repeats: uploading state (5x), FFmpeg deploy (6x), GCS URL format (4x). Bot found real bugs throughout — did not fully converge until round 15-16.

reviews.title: Reorganize asset storage: photos/{section_id}/ and video/
reviews.notes: Migration-heavy PR. 7 rounds. R1: 3 valid (shared image copy, path traversal, dead regex). R2: 3 valid (critical .add() vs = bug, ObjectId validation, double-prefix URLs). R3: 0. R4: 2 valid (tuple crash, double-move removal). R5: 1 valid (double-prefix key mismatch in content rewrite). R6: 1 valid (deploy order). R7: 0. Bot caught a crash-on-run bug (tuple) and a silent data loss bug (.add() vs =). 73% hit rate.

reviews.title: Public contact form with Turnstile, honeypot, and email notifications
reviews.notes: Security-focused contact form. 6 rounds. R1: 6/6 valid (IP forwarding through proxy, blocking SMTP, error detail leak, Turnstile fail-open, duplicate form render, static import bloat). R2: 0. R3: 3 valid (IP spoofing, email in logs, missing onError), 2 repeats. R4: 1 valid (Turnstile cleanup), 1 FP (IP already fixed), 2 repeats. R5: 3 valid (rate limit key_func, CRLF injection, httpx timeout), 2 repeats. R6: 2 valid (meta indentation, Cloud Run IP), 2 repeats (slug hardcode x4). 63% hit rate.

reviews.title: CSP blocking Turnstile and skip name/email for logged-in users
reviews.notes: Small fix PR. 4 rounds. R1: 2 valid (broken test, null display name 422). R2: 1 valid (misleading useState initializer), 1 FP (empty name unreachable due to isAuthenticated guard). R3: 1 valid (connect-src missing for Turnstile), 2 repeats (null name, name > 100 chars nitpick). R4: 2 repeats (null name untested, dead code fallback). Converged R3-R4. 44% hit rate.
